name: feature-widgets
purpose: The "three ways to start" band of a product page: a centered section title with up to two calls to action, over a bento grid where every cell is a live console scene (or an illustration) above a bold-led sentence and its affordances — a link button, a copy button that puts a prompt on the clipboard and confirms it with "Copied" for two seconds, or both. A cell's scene plays its beat while the pointer is over the cell. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'feature-widgets', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `frame-box`, `bento-grid`, `illustration`, `button-highlight` and the webkit scene assets.
useWhen: Use FeatureWidgets when each cell has its own action or copy button.
To offer the same outcome through two or three entry points (agent, console, terminal), each with its own next step.
avoidWhen: For reasons without an action per cell → use `feature-tiles` (with pictures) or `capability-grid` (without).
For a long argument per feature → use `feature-scroll`.
related: bento-grid` — the grid the cells are laid in.
button-highlight` — the copy affordance a cell renders when it carries `copy`.
bestPractices: Give each item an `action` (a link), a `copy` (text to put on the clipboard), or both when the reader may want the docs and the prompt.
On a product page give each item a `scene` naming a `ProductWidget` fragment (`{ component: 'ProductWidget', props: { name } }`); keep `illustration` for cells with no console to show.
Keep `copy.text` self-contained; it is what the reader pastes into their agent.
Set `anchor` when a hero button scrolls to this band.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the section title as its `h2`, and the accessible name of the band.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second, outlined button under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

props.name: titleVariant
props.doc: Alignment of the section title over the grid: `center`, `start` or `split`.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Column count of the grid from the medium breakpoint up: `2`, `3` or `4`.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.doc: Label a cell's copy button shows for two seconds after a copy; empty uses the catalog's `Copied`.

props.name: items
props.doc: The cells, in order; each is `{ title, description, scene?, illustration?, action?, copy? }` where `scene` is `{ component, props? }` naming a webkit scene asset drawn in a 20rem window and handed `hover` while the pointer is over the cell, `illustration` is drawn when no scene is set, `action` is `{ label, href }` rendered as an outlined link button and `copy` is `{ label, text }` rendered as a copy button that puts `text` on the clipboard; a cell may carry both.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureWidgets from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-widgets'
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureWidgets
    anchor="get-started"
    eyebrow="Get started"
    title="Start where you already work"
    description="The same function, three ways to ship it. Hand it to a coding agent, build it in the Console, or deploy it from the terminal."
    :primary-action="{ label: 'Start for free', href: '/signup' }"
    :secondary-action="{ label: 'Docs', href: '/site/docs', trailing: true }"
    :columns="3"
    :items="[
      {
        title: 'Ask your coding agent',
        description:
          'Connect the Azion MCP servers to Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT, and the agent creates, instances and routes the function, with a dry run before every write.',
        illustration: 'deploy-secure-mcp-server',
        copy: {
          label: 'Copy prompt',
          text: 'Create a function that answers 401 when a request has no Authorization header.'
        }
      },
      {
        title: 'Build it in the Console',
        description:
          'Choose the application it runs on, write the handler in the editor, name it, and create it. The rule that runs it is drafted for you.',
        illustration: 'build-applications',
        action: { label: 'Docs', href: '/site/docs' }
      },
      {
        title: 'Ship it from the terminal',
        description:
          'azion init scaffolds from 25 presets, azion dev serves it on localhost:3333, and azion deploy puts it on a live domain.',
        illustration: 'quick-start-with-templates',
        action: { label: 'Docs', href: '/site/docs' }
      }
    ]"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Live scenes
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureWidgets from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-widgets'

  const docs = 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/build/applications/'

  const items = [
    {
      title: 'Cache settings you reuse.',
      description:
        'Set the CDN TTL, stale cache and large file optimization once, then reuse the setting wherever the application needs it.',
      scene: { component: 'ProductWidget', props: { name: 'application-cache' } },
      action: { label: 'Docs', href: docs }
    },
    {
      title: 'Rules that decide what is cached.',
      description:
        'Match a path, a method or a header, and attach a cache setting to just that traffic.',
      scene: { component: 'ProductWidget', props: { name: 'application-rule' } },
      action: { label: 'Docs', href: docs }
    },
    {
      title: 'Functions for the cases rules miss.',
      description:
        'Rewrite cache headers on the response in a few lines of JavaScript, running in every data center before the response leaves.',
      scene: { component: 'ProductWidget', props: { name: 'application-function' } },
      action: { label: 'Docs', href: docs },
      copy: {
        label: 'Copy prompt',
        text: 'Write an Azion function that sets cache-control to public, max-age=3600 on every response from /assets.'
      }
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureWidgets
    anchor="built-in"
    eyebrow="Built in"
    title="Every cache control in one application"
    description="Cache settings, the rules that apply them and the functions that shape responses live inside the application, versioned and deployed with it."
    :columns="3"
    :items="items"
  />
</template>
